Let's stick to the most common one. You start with a retinoid. Then on night two, you use a chemical exfoliant, and on night three, you take a rest, and then you repeat the cycle. Again, not a needless hater, so there are pros to this, which I will acknowledge. First of all, it's easy to follow if you're a beginner. I also like that it discourages layering the act. But you can't layer the actives anyway. Even a beginner who's introducing these actives is probably gonna go on Google and search, can I use this and this together? They're gonna find out no, so they're gonna use them on different days anyway. Secondly, your skin has no concept of time. People will rave about one of the benefits of skin cycling being your skin, not Getting irritated because you're using actives on separate days. Your skin doesn't know you're using it on separate days. Your skin doesn't care if you use it on Tuesday and Thursday. It's not gonna be like, well, I'm not gonna overreact because she used it with a couple of days in between. Which leads me to my third point, which is my biggest gripe about it.
